description:
This release fixes a few bugs for the client and server. Updating is recommended.

Changes:
 - Fixed direct connections not being removed when they disconnect
 - Fixed some annoying console errors related to [http-over-websocket](https://github.com/termermc/http-over-websocket)
 - Fixed server HTTP external auth rejecting correct `Content-Type` response header when it contained a charset field
 - Fixed server HTTP external auth doubling its request headers on every request
 - Fixed PDFs being previewed as raw text
 - Added a limit of 1MiB for previewing files as text
